channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high on inflation, spending concerns
item.description: Tuesday saw yields on U.S. 30-year Treasury yields add over 1 basis point to trade at around 5.322%, hovering just below its highest level since 2002.

item.title: Disney-owned ABC files First Amendment lawsuit against FCC
item.description: Disney's ABC has sued the FCC claiming its investigation and early broadcast licenses renewal are a 'retaliatory campaign' due to its programming.

item.title: Home Depot reaffirms guidance amid 'frozen housing market conditions'
item.description: Home Depot reported second fiscal quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations on the top and bottom lines.

item.title: American Airlines to add seatback screens, bigger first class in race to catch up to Delta and United
item.description: American is trying to add more premium seating and passenger perks after falling behind rivals Delta and United.

item.title: Contrarian vs. the crowd: One trader made a massive bet against chip stocks
item.description: The biggest single options trade in the entire market Monday was a $129 million bet against the VanEck Semiconductor ETF.

item.title: Popular language app is on the cusp of a turnaround. Buy the stock now, D.A. Davidson says
item.description: Duolingo is showing signs of winning back users and finding new paths to monetize its language-learning platform, D.A. Davidson says.

item.title: Crypto exchange Kraken launches cash back debit card in bid for consumer wallets
item.description: Kraken is vying for a place in consumer wallets as crypto evolves from an asset class into infrastructure for mainstream financial products.

item.title: Nvidia's AI moat is shifting from chips to capital
item.description: Nvidia still has dominant market share in AI chips, but with competition picking up steam, the company is taking greater advantage of another key asset.

item.title: Sea Ray parent Brunswick bets on AI navigation and new revenue streams to help stalling boat sales
item.description: Brunswick Corp. CEO David Foulkes told CNBC premium boat sales are staying afloat, while value options are lagging.

item.title: Trump's Oman bomb threat an attempt to get their 'attention,' says former ambassador
item.description: The attack caused damage to the engine room and resulted in a crew casualty, UKMTO said, adding that the remaining crew were being assisted by the Omani Coast Guard.

item.title: Lakers governor Jeanie Buss says siblings cannot sell family’s stake to Bob Iger, Joshua Kushner
item.description: Jeanie Buss's lawyer says she has not agreed to sell the team and that any vote suggesting the Buss family is selling "would be and is void."

item.title: The top 10 colleges for financial aid in 2026, according to The Princeton Review — and what families actually pay
item.description: With cost a top concern, these colleges are considered the most generous with their financial aid packages.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Tuesday
item.description: The bond market is the story of the day.

item.title: 'Worrisome': AI is driving a looming market correction, European central bank economists warn
item.description: History suggests valuations will tumble even if they are a fair reflection of the transformative power of AI, according to a European Central Bank analysis.

item.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California
item.description: Meta faces a federal trial over child safety claims that could bring major financial penalties and changes to Facebook and Instagram.

item.title: How investors profit from soccer even as Premier League club losses skyrocket
item.description: While English football clubs are gaining popularity with investors across the globe, teams remain risky and often unprofitable ventures.

item.title: Prediction markets entrant Novig posts more than $125 million in trading volume during its first week
item.description: The newly launched Novig has reported over $125 million in notional trading volume.

item.title: Options investors are betting on this trend in gold prices, Susquehanna says
item.description: Gold is seeing muted volatility, firmer upside skew and renewed inflows.

item.title: Sanders proposes bill to stop Social Security benefit garnishment for unpaid student loans
item.description: Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., announced a new proposal on Monday to protect federal student loan borrowers from having their Social Security checks garnished.

item.title: South Korea must brace for ‘worst-case scenario,’ President Lee says, as Trump cuts military drills
item.description: The annual exercises, are defensive and not intended to attack North Korea or raise tensions on the peninsula, Lee said.

item.title: 'Absolutely crazy': Here's what South Korean stock investors are doing in U.S. markets
item.description: South Korean stock investors have made 'absolutely crazy' bets as they flee their home market, while global investors pile in.

item.title: The best retirement planning tools for every stage of your journey
item.description: Planning for retirement doesn’t have to be complicated. With just an app, you can manage your money and keep your long-term goals in sight.

item.title: Russia says its economy is strong. It just fired a top economist who warned otherwise
item.description: Andrei Klepach was reportedly fired from his role after presenting a report warning that Russia could not win a prolonged war of attrition with Ukraine.

item.title: The startup using AI to help rare disease families develop custom treatments
item.description: Nome uses AI and drug-development expertise to help rare disease families turn genetic diagnoses into potential paths toward treatment.

item.title: Anthropic tells investors annualized revenue run rate climbed to $65 billion in July
item.description: Anthropic's revenue run rate is up about sevenfold from a year earlier.

item.title: Disney's new parks boss outlines investment strategy, with superfans at the fore
item.description: Disney Experiences chief Thomas Mazloum is focused on balancing the needs of its most ardent parkgoers with its less frequent visitors.

item.title: Paramount seeks $1.88 billion bond from state AGs to cover costs of WBD merger delay
item.description: Paramount agreed to delay its proposed acquisition of WBD to as late as June 2027 while the state AGs' case heads to trial.

item.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump bid to overturn E. Jean Carroll verdict
item.description: President Trump was held civilly liable in the case by a New York federal jury for defaming and sexually abusing the writer E. Jean Carroll.

item.title: Nvidia backing $105 billion in financing for OpenAI data center in Ohio
item.description: Technology giants are shelling out billions to scale capacity to meet massive data center demand.

item.title: Looking for under-the-radar stocks? Cramer gives his take on 5 unfamiliar names
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer took a fresh look at five stocks viewers asked about, including ExlService, MakeMyTrip, Establishment Labs, NVE and Ubiquiti.
